narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Quarter folds are so neat that the creases always make a square.
<bookmark mark='fit'/>Tilt the crease so it runs far along one fold and only a little along the other.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The shape stretches out long and thin, so it cannot be a square.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble: always a square; the crease shape is redrawn long along one fold and short along the other; a square outline laid over it does not fit; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>When you fold into quarters, the folds become the diagonals of the shape.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Equal cuts along both folds make equal diagonals, and then you get a square.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. The crease cuts four centimetres along one fold and six along the other. Name the shape and find its diagonals.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the napkin; two lines: the folds are the diagonals; equal cuts on both folds give a square; then a new task: the crease cuts 4 cm on one fold and 6 cm on the other, with two empty boxes
